title: Quarkdown documentation index
description: Pre-extracted documentation of the Quarkdown functions of a documentation module, emitted as docs-index.json by the Quarkdoc Dokka plugin next to the module's HTML documentation.

name.description: The name of the documentation resource, matching the function's page name.

moduleName.description: The name of the Quarkdown module containing the function.

contentMarkdown.description: The function's full documentation content, in Markdown.

isLikelyChained.description: Whether the function is likely to be called via chaining syntax.

description.description: The description of the parameter, in Markdown.

isLikelyNamed.description: Whether the parameter is likely to be passed as a named argument.

isLikelyBody.description: Whether the parameter is likely to be passed as a body argument.

allowedValues.description: The allowed enum values of the parameter, or null if unconstrained.
